en.plugins.chatgpt.desc: AI chat using ChatGPT (OpenAI), with image support
en.plugins.chatgpt.no_key: ⚙️ OPENAI_API_KEY is not configured. Add it to config.env to use this command.
en.plugins.chatgpt.usage:
📌 *Usage:*
{0}gpt <question>

Example: {0}gpt What is Node.js?
Or send / reply to an image with {0}gpt to analyze it.
en.plugins.chatgpt.default_image_prompt: What's in this image? Describe it in detail.
en.plugins.chatgpt.no_answer: ❌ ChatGPT did not return an answer. Please try again.
